scope: selected point only, no model run; binary input reconstructions checked against recorded hashes
method: IEEE binary64 nearest operations widened down one representable number after each subtraction/addition/multiplication; c1 nonnegative; exact-real lower bounds assuming standard rounding, finite inputs and gradual underflow
limits: Selected point only, no direction-neighborhood or full input context proof.
Does not directly evaluate EOS inverse density alt or certify EOS power argument, FP operation error, FD error, or forcing residual.
Reconstruction of base and coefficients uses initialized wrfout and verified FNV hashes; U_eval uses separately verified byte SHA.
